subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Which remaining multi-agent orchestration contract should own #43367 before any more automated fixes are queued?
rationale: Config mutation and OAuth refresh slices have current mitigations, but session-lock recovery, durable completion delivery, fallback parent cancellation, and metadata-only child completion still require owner/product decisions across open linked issues and PRs.

options.title: Keep umbrella, land narrow fixes
options.body: Keep #43367 open as the umbrella, prioritize #86540/#86538 and the other canonical subtrackers, and block new broad bot fixes until those contracts are settled.

options.title: Split by canonical subtrackers
options.body: Move each remaining symptom to its canonical issue and close this umbrella only after every linked failure mode has a live owner or explicit rejection.

options.title: Sponsor orchestration redesign
options.body: Treat this as a broader agent-orchestration redesign with explicit semantics for metadata-only completion, cancellation, retry, and durable delivery.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella, land narrow fixes
recommendation.body: Keep #43367 open as the umbrella, prioritize #86540/#86538 and the other canonical subtrackers, and block new broad bot fixes until those contracts are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: The umbrella crosses config, session, gateway, and subagent-delivery boundaries where current-main history points to steipete as the strongest routing owner.
